blurb: Supernova Dance Company offers competitive dance training for serious dancers ages 5 to 18, requiring auditions and a significant time commitment. They also provide recreational dance classes with flexible scheduling and a special needs dance team for ages 8 and up. The competitive team participates in regional and national competitions and conventions, with mandatory choreography camps and rehearsals.
extraNote: Registration fee $30 per student, max $50 per family, non-refundable · Tuition billed monthly Sept-June, consistent payments regardless of holidays or closings · Company fees billed monthly Aug-June include competition fees and costume deposits · Early cancellation fees apply · Fall/Spring season September through June
